from_quote: an unrestrained power to alter the time, manner and place of electing members into that body
rationale: The paragraph names the power of Congress to alter the time, manner and place of elections and calls it "the fourth section," which is the first clause of Article I, Section 4.

from_quote: The unlimited power over trade, domestick as well as foreign
rationale: The paragraph names the power over trade, domestic and foreign, which is granted to Congress in Article I, Section 8, clause 3.
